promptText: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one original native 1254 x 1254 terrain patch precisely continuing the approved hand-painted fantasy game map. Image 1 is the exact local layout: repaint its existing shapes with crisp native detail; its blur is only a coordinate guide, never final pixels. Image 2 is the north native strip matching the top 230 pixels. Image 3 is the west native strip matching the left 230 pixels. Preserve the positions, surface transitions and edge geometry of both strips; do not stretch, resize or invent forms. Image 4 is the approved full map for art direction only, not objects to copy into this patch. Entire patch is uninterrupted turquoise open shallow sea, no sand, no rocks, no land. Match existing native north and west water hue and ripple/foam scale. Fine irregular thin white caustic lines over gently faceted translucent aqua water; no new dramatic breaking wave, no shoreline ring or isolated objects. Guide has only a subtly pale streak toward upper-right, keep that soft under-water light. Refined rounded Q Daoist hand-painted game art, diffuse bright daylight, same elevated camera and object scale, restrained mineral detail and painterly surface depth. Keep the exact existing coast; no added rocks, architecture, vegetation, props, characters, text, interface, borders or grid markings. Native original detail, not an enlarged overview. Output the complete square terrain patch, no reference montage.
